dedupe_keys.name: moldpos national gnss positioning system of moldova

description: MOLDPOS is the national positioning system of the Republic of Moldova, a network of ground GNSS reference stations that gives users corrections for positioning to a few centimetres, beyond the metre-level accuracy of GPS alone. Moldova joined the European Position Determination System (EUPOS) on 23 April 2008, and the control centre is at the INGEOCAD Institute of Geodesy, Technical Surveys and Cadastre, which serves all users. The site shows the stations on a map and has pages for MOLDPOS services, the network configuration, registration, important documents and connection settings. News items report that, on the initiative of the Agency for Land Relations and Cadastre with World Bank support, Galileo was added to GPS and GLONASS, with real-time corrections through the NTRIP mountpoint MSM, that five licences were bought to add new stations, that the IGEO station in Chișinău had its equipment replaced in September 2025, and that the service IP address changed. Access is by registration; prices are not given on the pages read. Caveats: the site is mainly in Romanian and Russian, and service interruptions during modernisation are announced on the news pages. Coverage is Moldova. It supports positioning infrastructure studies and space weather effects on GNSS; related records are ASG-EUPOS of Poland and CZEPOS of the Czech Republic.
